profile.summary: A nonprofit in Oakland that teaches and performs Black gospel and spiritual music traditions. It runs about 10 choirs for singers of many ages and backgrounds, offers youth education programs, and does community outreach in places such as schools, shelters and prisons.

sources.title: Oakland Interfaith Gospel Choir Inc - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: Agenda name matches exactly the Oakland, CA 501(c)(3) (EIN 94-3123450, ProPublica) whose website describes youth gospel music education programs and outreach at schools, consistent with OUSD's arts and music school agreements. Summary, address, phone and generic admin email were all confirmed on oigc.org; the site does not mention OUSD explicitly, but the name, city and services fit.
